description.text:
Pure’s mission is simple: to put pleasure into food made for people on the go or at work, without sacrificing goodness. Their delicious menu is freshly prepared daily in the on-site kitchen.

You’ll find freshly-baked pastries, served alongside coffee made from locally-roasted 100% Arabica beans which are ground to order for maximum freshness. You can choose from organic dairy, or free plant milk alternatives at no extra cost and bring in your reusable cup to get £1 off! Their breakfast range has everything from porridge and birchers to breakfast toasties, rolled omelettes and protein-packed super eggs. For lunch there’s just as much to choose from, including wheat bran wraps, hot Pure bowls (check out their best-selling High Protein Chilli!), salads and grain bowls that are hand-made to seasonal recipes. Cold pressed juices and smoothies are the perfect accompaniment to any breakfast or lunch. Plus, you can use their free filtered water stations to stay hydrated on to go – even if you aren’t buying anything.

All Pure’s ingredients are carefully sourced to bring you top-quality products, and they want to make it easy and delicious for people to reduce the amount of meat they eat, which is why over half their menu is vegan or veggie.

Pure also offers catering, just order before 10.45am and you can have lunch delivered to your office on the same day.

description.text:
The Paul French family have been making bread and patisserie with passion since 1889. Paul still bake their bread in the traditional hand-crafted way, using only fresh, natural ingredients.

Start the day with a freshly brewed coffee and a warm croissant straight from the oven. At lunchtime you'll be spoilt for choice with their range of generously and imaginatively filled sandwiches made fresh everyday. All their rustic sandwiches are made from their own bread, so you know they're going to be wonderfully tasty

If you're planning a meeting and need to impress your clients, Paul can arrange a selection of canapes and mini cakes - just the ticket!

Every item in PAULs glorious patisserie range is une petite splendeur and an invitation to be festive. Designed to lift the spirits, every cake, tart or treat is a little celebration in itself. Come and enjoy this little piece of France amid the hustle.

Location: Cabot Place

A home to those who value craft and quality, our aspiration is to be the local hero of choice. 
	
Dedicated to transparent, ethical coffee and food supply chains, we source seasonally from the best producers around the world.

The vibrant purple shop is Badiani’s latest addition to Canary Wharf within Cabot Place and is the perfect destination for those craving a sweet treat, an Italian coffee or one of their signature creative specialities such as their gelato croissant.

Established in Florence, Italy, in 1932, Badiani has been perfecting the art of artisanal ice cream for nearly a century. Badiani Cabot Place not only features classic favourites like Buontalenti, La Dolcevita, and Dark Chocolate Sorbet but also introduces their exclusive Coppa Gelato— a unique Badiani take on the classic gelato sundae.

At Badiani Cabot Place, you can enjoy a diverse array of sweet treats including cups and cones of gelato or sorbet, pinguinos, gelato cakes as well as gelato croissants and gelato burgers and more.

Pair their range of pastries with one of our Italian coffees, or indulge in a freshly made crepe. With a comfortable seating area, their shop is the perfect place to relax and enjoy these delights.

Give your body a healthy dose of vitamins and minerals with freshly made nutritious juices and healthy sandwiches, salads, and breakfast bowls from Joe & The Juice at Cabot Place. This Canary Wharf restaurant also serves organic coffee, vegan shakes, and other treats. This establishment has a growing reputation, thanks to the quality of its food and beverages, as well as its lively, entertaining atmosphere, chic Scandinavian-designed furniture, and tailored music profiles. Joe & The Juice is a fine choice if you’re looking for a grab-and-go lunch that you can enjoy in a park or at your desk, or if you’re looking for a trendy spot to enjoy a leisurely meal and a catch-up with your friends.

For 10,950 mornings – or 30 years – the pursuit of better ingredients, better craftsmanship and better taste has been what gets Ole & Steen up in the morning. It’s this pursuit that made two Danish bakers wake up with the same vision all those years ago – to create a better bakery for all. Better morning coffee and weekend delights. Better lunches, treats and celebrations. How? By refining simple recipes, experimenting and serving the result in beautiful surroundings.

It’s now been 30 years since it all started in our first Lagkagehuset bakery in Copenhagen, and our first UK bakery opened on 19th December 2016 on Haymarket, under the name “Ole & Steen”. Today more than 300 bakers work to support the Danish, London and New York bakeries. We have a few more bakeries these days and we want even more people to be able to wake up to better bread. So, whether you live in Denmark, London or New York, that’s what gets us up – morning after morning, year after year.

Since first opening in London at the end of 2016, Denmark's favourite bakers have wowed locals, visitors and media with the extraordinary quality of their bread, pastries and cakes. A household name back home, Ole & Steen have truly taken London by storm and have now brought their outstanding food to Canary Wharf with a new bakery at Crossrail Place.

Open from early breakfast until late, the bakery offers everything from single-estate coffee, cold-pressed juices, and snegl (delicious cinnamon pastry swirls) to lunchtime open sandwiches on rye bread - including the mouth-watering open rye sandwich with rare roast beef, remoulade, pickled cucumber and crispy shallots, or Danish blue cheese with pear, chestnuts and watercress, artisan sandwich baguettes and premium salads.

Ole & Steen is also the perfect place to wind-down with friends after work with a selection of wines and beers, mouth-watering flavoured focaccia, amazing flatbreads and warming stews of the day served with moorish skagen bread.

From the creators of Mercato Metropolitano (MM), MMy Wood Wharf is your neighbourhood corner store that specialises in artisanal, natural and sustainable food in a community market format. MMy will condense the typical MM offer to include a variety of artisanal kitchens, an international deli/grocery store, a considerable selection of organic and biodynamic wines from small vineyards, an explosion of local and European cheeses, artisanal bakery products and a music club.

MMy is founded on the understanding that each local community needs a centre of aggregation around food, social values and sharing experience, where the elements of inclusiveness, sustainability and healthy lifestyle remain at the core of the offer. MM wants to reach out to local residents not only to offer them a sustainable, artisanal and healthy alternative to chain restaurants and sandwich bars, but also to convey the sense of food as a prime Human Right.

Wood Wharf welcomes Signorelli — an independent, family-run bakery founded in 2015 by husband-and-wife team Rebecca and Alberto. Known for their famous pistachio cream croissant, Italian roast coffee and handmade focaccias toasties, they serve up artisan bakes with a personal touch. Their food is made using only high-quality ingredients sourced from local, like-minded small businesses. Pop in for their popular lunch deal: focaccia sandwich + drink + a free handmade cookie. Planning an event? They cater for up to 300 guests with the same quality and care you’ll find in store. Come see what the fuss is about, in their cosy corner of Wood Wharf.

"Cafe Seek: Where Every Sheep Finds Its Pasture"
Cafe Seek is a charming Japanese bakery nestled in London. When you taste our baked goods, they transport you to our dream world. Here, you can forget all the noise of the world around you and realize that you, too, can just be yourself.

Pinky and Emily, our founders, firmly believe that food can influence people's lives. No matter how challenging your journey may be, 'Seek' will walk through each step with you.

We prepare all our goods with love and patience. Our breads and cakes are baked fresh to maintain their crispness and moisture for the best taste and texture. With carefully selected domestic flour and the finest ingredients, we ensure you will have the premium experience of enjoying our baked goods.

Seek's standout feature is the variety of cake and bread designs we offer. We combine French pastry techniques with Japanese flavors to create a unique fusion. With homemade fillings like purple sweet potato paste and Daifuku, among others, you can savor not only the appearance but also the texture of our goods. Enjoy and relax!
